Meet the Baker

Your Local Cake Artist

DannyRich Bakery bakes a wide range of breads and celebration cakes, from birthday and wedding cakes to anniversary creations.

Beyond cakes, the bakery also serves pastries, parfaits, and smoothies, making it a one-stop treat shop for every craving.
